context: Riku and Daichi discuss a board game tournament.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (ゴール/スピード/プレイ/連続/盤) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 将棋の大会、出てみたいんだ。
lines.en: I want to enter a shogi tournament.
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ええなあ、盤の前で集中するんやろ?
lines.en: Nice, you focus in front of the board, right?
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm hearty delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 盤を見て、スピードよく指すんだ。
lines.en: You look at the board and move quickly.
lines.style: animated teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 連続で勝てたら、かっこええなー。
lines.style: cheerful Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 相手のプレイを、読むのが大事なんだ。
lines.style: thoughtful teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: ゲームにも、ゴールがあるんやな。
lines.en: Games have a goal too, huh.
lines.style: lively Kansai man voice, warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、勝ちっていうゴールを目指すんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, you aim for the goal of winning.
lines.style: enthusiastic teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 連続優勝、応援しとるで!
lines.en: I'm rooting for a winning streak!
lines.style: warm Kansai man voice, warm hearty closing delivery throughout
